subject: Redwood discovery recap + next steps (Verdant Analytics)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@verdant.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + discovery recap: Redwood x Verdant Analytics

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side so we both have the same next steps: 

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for batch and interactive workflows while keeping tail-latency under 150ms for critical queries.
- Current infra: in-house GPU cluster + managed embeddings for search; throughput spikes during end-of-month reports.
- Key constraints: data residency (US-only), SOC2 evidence required, and predictable per-token cost for budgeting.

Action items we agreed on:
1) I’ll share a short proposal with an estimated cost delta and recommended deployment mode (Dedicated vs. Hosted + Private control plane options) — ETA: 2–3 business days.
2) Aditya (cc) will follow up on technical questions around model quantization and KV cache behavior for your 8k-context runs.
3) You’ll share a sample workload snapshot (anonymized) and the timeline for the procurement window (expected decision by end of Q3).

Attaching a short one-pager summary and a checklist of SOC2 artifacts you asked about. Happy to jump back on a call if you want to walk through the cost numbers together.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: discovery-onepager.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up on next steps (Verdant)

Hey Alex —

Just checking in on the sample workload and procurement timeline we discussed last week. I know things get busy — would love to lock in a quick 15-min window to walk through the proposal assumptions if that helps.

Proposed times: Thu 8/26 10:00am PT or Fri 8/27 11:00am PT. If those don’t work, tell me a time that does and I’ll send an invite.

Thanks,
Marissa

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal and cost estimate (attached) — Redwood x Verdant

Hi Alex / Samantha —

Following up with the proposal I mentioned on our call. Highlights:

- Estimated monthly delta vs. current: ~22% lower at target throughput (assumes modest batching and prefix caching).
- Recommended: start with Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency, add Private control plane for SOC2 workflows.
- Migration: phased rollout (POC -> Pilot -> Prod) over 6–8 weeks; low-risk fallbacks included.

Attached: Verdant-Redwood-Proposal.pdf (includes price table, rollout plan, and list of SOC2 artifacts).

If helpful, Aditya can join a short technical review to cover quantization and batching settings. Are you available this week for 20 minutes?

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: Verdant-Redwood-Proposal.pdf (PDF, 92KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@verdant.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Closing the loop — should I close the file?

Alex —

Haven’t heard back after the proposal, so wanted to close the loop. If Verdant is still planning to move forward this quarter I’m happy to prioritize a technical dive and procurement checklist. If priorities have shifted, I can close the file for now and re-open when the timing is right.

Options:
- We keep this open and schedule a 20-min technical review this week (Aditya + me).
- You tell me to close the file and I’ll check back in next quarter.

Would love a brief thumbs up/thumbs down so I can keep the right cadence.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@verdant.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Closing the loop — should I close the file?

Thanks for the follow-up, Marissa. We reviewed the proposal and decided to deprioritize vendor changes until our end-of-year data platform refresh is complete. Please close the file for now — we’ll reach out when the refresh is done (likely Q1 next year). Appreciate the clear proposal and the time.

Best,
Alex
VP Engineering | Verdant Analytics
